card.band: 8 h. The build is heavy and the rules are intricate. A frontier agent gets simple turns and roundabouts but misses collapsing of short steps, merges and name-change rules. A weaker model fails to get the build running.

card.grading: The upstream cucumber guidance features and unit tests run offline on bundled OSM data. Hidden extra scenarios are generated on other small OSM extracts. Maneuver type, modifier, bearings and step order are compared exactly to reference output.

spike_plan.kill_if: Build needs network or cannot be made offline; the cucumber suite is nondeterministic; or the reference cannot reproduce the feature outputs.
spike_plan.pass_if: Build finishes offline in under 1h; feature suite is deterministic across two runs; removing guidance drops the pass rate to near zero; a reduced subset of about 5-8 feature files runs cleanly.
steps: In a throwaway networked Linux container, clone the repo at f2147ea and run the offline build (cmake, Boost, TBB, expat, Lua, bz2, zlib deps via apt).
Run the cucumber guidance features on a single small bundled extract (e.g. features/guidance/turn.feature and roundabout.feature) and record the pass/fail counts per feature file.
Run the same features twice and diff outputs to check determinism.
Remove src/guidance and its headers in a scratch copy, rebuild, and confirm the features fail (non-trivial base score of 0).
Check whether the reduced scope (turn, roundabout, collapse, merge, new-name features) can be run with the reference alone and time the full cucumber pass.

v1.summary: The upstream OSRM guidance code is real, pinned, BSD-2-Clause and has a 47-file cucumber suite, so Real, Ref and Surf are strong. The whole guidance layer is about 20 frontier hours against an 8h tier and the public source is recallable and in Debian, so it fails K9 as specified; a rescoped subset of the feature files would be the path to a valid seed.
